description:
Unofficial desktop app for Facebook Messenger, without the rest of Facebook.

Chatpane wraps the Facebook Messenger web app in a small native window and strips away the rest of Facebook: no Feed, no Reels, no Marketplace. It adds native notifications, an unread badge and privacy options.
Chatpane is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc. Messenger and Facebook are trademarks of Meta.
The app icon you pick in Settings now shows on the Windows taskbar, and Chatpane's windows have an icon again under X11 on Linux.
Bug Fixes
- Windows: the icon you choose in Settings → Appearance → App icon now shows on the taskbar, pinned or not, and on Chatpane's Desktop and Start menu shortcuts. Before, the taskbar kept the default icon even after a restart. A shortcut you gave an icon of your own is left alone.
- Linux: under X11, Chatpane's windows now show the chosen app icon. They had no icon at all. Wayland is unchanged.
